description: A team manager must decide how to respond to concerns that Morgan's feedback style is disrupting collaboration, whether Morgan should continue facilitating the weekly planning meeting, and what operating safeguards should be put in place.

shared_context.S1: Two team members have raised concerns that Morgan's corrections during planning discussions can feel abrupt and have made handoffs more difficult.
shared_context.S2: Morgan currently facilitates the team's weekly planning meeting.
shared_context.S3: Elena must finalize the response, the facilitation assignment, and the collaboration safeguards.
shared_context.S4: As part of the team's routine case-review process, Elena asks the employee concerned and the HR business partner to state relevant observations, commitments, and practical constraints before she records the decision.

PF1.text: For the next 30 working days, Morgan must leave work meetings by 15:30 to provide caregiving support; Morgan can continue facilitating if the weekly planning meeting is scheduled to end by 15:30 and the arrangement is documented.

PF2.text: Ravi helped Morgan and the affected teammate make an informal agreement last quarter to give feedback in writing within 24 hours and hold a 20-minute weekly repair check-in for 30 days; Ravi kept the signed note, but it was not attached to the current case file.

acceptance_conditions: The response must be structured coaching rather than formal discipline.
The finding must characterize the matter as a communication conflict.
Morgan must remain the weekly planning facilitator.
The weekly planning meeting must end by 15:30.
The collaboration plan must be documented.
The prior written-feedback and repair-check-in agreement must be recorded as an operating commitment.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'written_feedback' and c['target'] == 'Morgan' and c['detail'] == 'Give feedback in writing within 24 hours' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'weekly_repair_check_in' and c['target'] == 'Morgan' and c['detail'] == 'Hold a 20-minute check-in weekly for 30 days' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Morgan's caregiving requirement changes the meeting end time from an ordinary schedule to exactly no later than 15:30.
The retained agreement changes the settlement from general collaboration advice to written feedback within 24 hours and a 20-minute weekly repair check-in for 30 days.
